summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs so `python3 main.py` now prints `Hello, world!`: in `main.py` I changed the import from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`, and in `greeter.py` I added the missing colon on `def greet(name)`. I ran the program afterward to confirm it ex
